name: What is the process for vanity and cabinet installation with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for vanity and cabinet installation with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our installation process typically begins with an initial consultation and site visit to discuss your needs and take precise measurements. We then provide a detailed quote and timeline. Once approved, we order materials or begin custom fabrication. The installation phase involves careful demolition of old units if needed, preparing the space, installing the new cabinets or vanity, and ensuring all components, such as plumbing and hardware, are correctly integrated. We emphasize clear communication throughout the project, culminating in a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with consultation and measurements, followed by a quote, material ordering, and careful installation including demolition and integration of components. We ensure satisfaction.
